scope: Synthetic samples and isolated data on one Windows laptop

unresolved_speech_failure.observation: All failed WAVs yielded different recognizer text from their matching typed inputs; 12 refused and 2 clarified.
unresolved_speech_failure.correction: Verified grounding retained. Better recording and recognition evidence is needed before widening speech matching.

verified_corrections.expected: Capture timeout or device-open failure releases a manual turn
verified_corrections.change: Classified completion and finished the turn

verified_corrections.expected: Muting releases the active microphone capture
verified_corrections.cause: Mute changed the gate without cancelling the turn
verified_corrections.change: Cancel and release manual capture on mute

verified_corrections.expected: A duration qualifier cannot cause an immediate power mutation
verified_corrections.before: A temporary-power request switched off the AC immediately
verified_corrections.cause: Duration was discarded during power matching
verified_corrections.change: Preserve scheduled timing and clarify unsupported temporary requests

verified_corrections.expected: Completed or silent manual input has actionable feedback
verified_corrections.before: Completed capture and no-speech result were hidden
verified_corrections.cause: No ready event and prerender filtering of silent replies
verified_corrections.change: Expose ready and silence feedback in voice clients

verified_corrections.expected: A managed desktop starts source from this checkout
verified_corrections.before: Source selected from the runtime checkout
verified_corrections.cause: Environment and code paths were coupled
verified_corrections.change: Load local source and reuse existing runtime/configuration

verified_corrections.expected: Ollama scheduling policy is distinct from measured GPU execution
verified_corrections.before: Settings showed Ollama gpu with zero resident model VRAM
verified_corrections.cause: Configured dispatch policy displayed as actual placement
verified_corrections.change: Label CPU request or automatic placement
